parts.t: Introducing Spratt Road - an extraordinary opportunity to own a breathtaking custom-built log home with stunning mountain views, nestled on 10 acres. This estate, chosen as the backdrop for 80 weddings, offers endless possibilities, including the potential to build a barn and bring your horses home. Entertain on the 1050 sqft deck, perfect for gatherings. The home features soaring vaulted ceilings, a river rock wood fireplace, and a spacious master bedroom with an office loft overlooking the surroundings. Indulge in the dreamy spa-like ensuite for relaxation. This property has been featured in movies, commercials, and even a Super Bowl commercial! Additional highlights include an in-law suite, a walk-out daylight basement, and a workshop. Schedule your private showing today!
